title: The Debosnys cryptograms, Essex County NY jail, 1882-83 (Schmeh Top 50 no. 3)

transcription.notes: 20 lines; line 12 under a stain. Counts from NOTES; transcription kept in a .py file. Glyph identity decisions are the weak point.
25 lines, plus 40 pictograms, clear initials and the numeral 516 not counted.

documents.shelfmark: Debosnys papers, page No. 10 cipher lines (c3.png)

transcription.notes: 4 lines incl. 6 pictograms, above a clear French poem.

system.summary: Composite invented glyphs, about 333 types in 969 tokens; line lengths and couplet rhymes point to a French syllabary, not proven.

diacritics.note: Glyphs are built from sub-glyph components (tilde, dots, crosses); whether these act as diacritics is unsettled.

system.notes: Verse is 20 lines of rhyming couplets (9 of 10 line-final glyph pairs identical). Sektu (2017) counted 1,188 tokens of 425 types in an unreleased transcription.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Line-final glyphs of the verse repeat in couplets (9 of 10), AABB rhyme scheme.
Found Sektu's 2017 transcription work and Brown's plagiarism finding (English sources); corrected the earlier novelty claim.
Transcribed the verse, No. 10 and No. 9: 969 glyphs, 333 types.
Unit comparison: glyphs per line fit French syllables only.
No. 10 as encoding of the clear poem below it (isomorph alignment vs planted control).
Verse as any 20-line window of 28 French verse volumes, Delille's Aeneid V, and Moore/Stoddart English sources.
'Monograph' reading: each glyph a stack of letter marks; real order no better than shuffled.
Clean syllabary of 1,000-20,000 syllables: annealing recovers 0-5 %; unicity distance about 800-2,000 glyphs.

outcome.method_basis: Rhyme scheme and syllable-unit statistics were found, but crib searches against verse sources and syllabary annealing failed; a matched control shows the text is below the unicity distance.
outcome.notes: Too short for a crib-free attack on a syllabary; needs a known plaintext (Essex County Historical Society papers).
